# Fine Sentence

> A comprehensive English learning platform combining interactive vocabulary training, dictionary resources, and specialized tools like emoji search and Braille translation.

Fine Sentence offers personalized English language learning through active vocabulary builders, curated word lists (including Oxford 3000 and IELTS), and a full-featured dictionary with definitions, examples, and translations. The platform gamifies learning with leaderboards and daily word challenges while providing grammar resources and accessibility tools.

## Key Topics

- English vocabulary
- Word Trainer
- Dictionary
- Grammar resources
- Word lists
- Etymology
- Verb conjugation
- Usage examples
- Synonyms
- Emoji Search
- Braille Translator
- Language learning
- Oxford 3000
- IELTS preparation
- Active vocabulary builder

## Core Learning Tools

- [Learn English Words Online | Dictionary & Word Trainer](https://finesentence.com): Homepage showcasing Word Trainer, Dictionary, and personalized learning tools
- [Learn English Words in Context. Active Vocabulary Builder](https://finesentence.com/learn-words): Active vocabulary trainer with 1000+ words in context and smart hints
- [Dictionary – English Words with Definitions and Examples](https://finesentence.com/dictionary): Online dictionary with definitions, translations, and practical examples
- [English Vocabulary Lists for Every Level](https://finesentence.com/wordlist): Curated vocabulary lists including Oxford 3000, IELTS, and multilevel learning

## Grammar & Language Reference

- [English Grammar Resources and Articles](https://finesentence.com/grammar): Comprehensive grammar guide covering tenses, parts of speech, and verb conjugation
- [Learn new words daily: expand your vocabulary](https://finesentence.com/learn/new-words-every-day): Daily vocabulary builder with word definitions and etymology exploration

## Specialized Tools

- [Emoji Search - Find & Copy Emojis by English Words | Free Emoji Finder](https://finesentence.com/emoji-search): Intelligent emoji search engine using word synonyms and associations
- [English to Braille Translator | Learn About Braille](https://finesentence.com/braille-translator): Braille translator tool with educational content on Braille grades and history

## Community & Engagement

- [Leaderboard - Top English Learners](https://finesentence.com/leaderboard): Gamified leaderboard showing top learners with points and rankings
- [Who We Are?](https://finesentence.com/about): About page describing Finesentence.com mission and platform background
